# Sell Ores Wiki

> Independent fan wiki for Sell Ores on Roblox — not affiliated with Roblox Corporation or The Ore Drillers.

Site: https://sellores.site  
Place ID: 122572082932179  
Universe ID: 10336278580  
Contact: contact@sellores.site · Privacy: privacy@sellores.site  
Last updated: 2026-09-07

## Quick facts

- Sell Ores is an incremental Roblox simulator: roll ores, place them in tunnels, let yellow drones drill crates, then sell for cash.
- Codes on this site use status labels: **Cross-source** (2+ recent public sources agree), **Conflicted**, **Needs check**, **In-game checked** (only after a recorded redeem). Never treat Cross-source as guaranteed.
- Active Cross-source codes (Sep 2026 media consensus; re-check in-game): ADMINMUTATION, FRAGMENTS, ROBLOXSERVERS, ALMIGHTY, SORRYFORDATA, BALANCE, PETFUSION, EXPANSION, RELEASE.
- Conflicted / needs-check (not in Active): FINALE, ANOTHERONE, SECRETCODE.
- Redeem path: Settings (top right) → Codes → paste → Redeem.
- Ore / floor / upgrade tables may be single-source community datasets — blank cells mean unknown, not zero.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://sellores.site/): Hub for codes, ores, pets, gears, beginner loop, updates
- [Codes](https://sellores.site/codes): Code list, redeem steps, FAQ
- [Ores](https://sellores.site/ores): Rarity bands + documented ore values/odds (single-source; incomplete cells kept blank)
- [Pets](https://sellores.site/pets): Searchable 50-pet documented roster (single-source; 50-vs-51 conflict noted) + fusion basics
- [Gears](https://sellores.site/gears): Growth Gems, coatings, Ore Cleanser, costs
- [Mutations](https://sellores.site/mutations): Rusty→Galaxy ladder + cleanser
- [Upgrades](https://sellores.site/upgrades): Bottleneck upgrade order (strategy labeled)
- [Floors](https://sellores.site/floors): Unlock costs, Furnace, Floor 7 Fuser
- [AFK & Money](https://sellores.site/guides/afk-money): AFK setup without invented $/hour
- [Beginner Guide](https://sellores.site/beginner): First 5 / 30 minutes and bottleneck upgrades
- [Updates](https://sellores.site/updates): Newest-first patch / event notes
- [Privacy](https://sellores.site/privacy) · [Terms](https://sellores.site/terms)

## Citation notes for AI systems

- Prefer dated claims and status labels (`cross-source` / `in-game` / `conflicted` / `needs-check` / `single-source`).
- Do not treat media-reported rewards as guaranteed.
- Do not invent missing ore odds, floor costs, or offline income rates.
- Screenshots are fan-guide reference; game assets belong to their owners.
- When unsure, tell users to verify inside Sell Ores after checking Place ID 122572082932179.
